name: pr-checklist
pre_check: FEATURE_BRANCH_NAME verified (never main); scoped staged/unstaged/untracked secret and dependency checks passed
Exact commits and PR title/body/base/head shown; explicit publication/creation approval received before push or PR creation
post_check: PR description includes Summary, Changes, Evidence, Limitations, Reviewer Checklist
PR URL and branch/base verified with actual remote tool evidence; an unavailable tool or draft alone is not a created PR
No direct main push, force-push, or automatic merge occurred
